name: directa-mcp
description: Positions, balance, orders and historical data from Directa SIM's Darwin platform.
long_description: Exposes Directa SIM's Darwin API (dAPI) as MCP tools: positions with derived prices and a reconciliation check, account balance and buying power, the day's orders, and OHLC candles and ticks. Darwin must be running and logged in on this machine — the extension talks to its local sockets, never to Directa over the internet. Order tools stay inert unless you enable them below.

enable_orders.title: Allow real orders
enable_orders.description: Off by default. While off, the tools that place, modify or cancel orders send nothing at all to Darwin. There is no simulated mode: with this on, orders are real, with real money.

autostart.title: Allow starting Darwin
autostart.description: Lets the start_darwin tool launch dGO so you can log in. It never completes the login by itself — Darwin asks for an OTP — and it never closes Darwin.
